metrics.description: Performance metrics for this frequency bin.

campaignIdFilter.description: List of campaign IDs to filter by. When level is CAMPAIGN, this filter specifies which campaigns to retrieve data for. When level is AD_GROUP, this filter specifies the parent campaign and the API will return requested ad groups under that campaigns. Only applicable when level is AD_GROUP or CAMPAIGN.

endDateFilter.description: End date until which frequency distribution insights will be returned. Must be within the past 90 days. If not set, defaults to current date. metricsFilter.description: List of performance metrics to include in the response.

startDateFilter.description: Start date from which frequency distribution insights will be returned. Must be within the past 90 days. If not set, defaults to last 15 days from end date. If only start date is set, returns data from start date to start date + 90 days.

date.description: Represents the day of the insight.

frequencyGroupId.description: Represents the ID of the frequency group associated with the insight. Will be included if frequencyGroupFrequencyCapfilter is used and frequencyGroupIds are not empty.
